headline: As of 2026-09-28: 354,516 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 21 of 50 states, D+45.1 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 354,516 early/mail ballots cast so far across 21 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+45.1 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (183,217), New Jersey (55,021), Wisconsin (36,552).
